meta.title: The buyer's surrogate bid upload for BOQ
gaps: The prepared event is not a live BOQ stage, and the catalog cannot change it into the required BOQ starting state.
Neither required company setting is established, and no second QA company ID is supplied; the ON and OFF Upload Excel expectations cannot be tested reliably.
The template-download control's exact label is unavailable, so the download cannot be triggered reliably to assert GET /v1/trade/<stage>/download_event_details with company_uuid.

Upload fixtures contain no .xlsx or .xls file and cannot supply a filled BOQ template; accepted file types, POST /v1/trade/<stage>/upload_bid_excel, and the Excel Uploaded Successfully toast cannot be verified.
Without the Excel upload, the plan cannot verify populated prices, unchanged bid count before Place bid, or the subsequent bid-count increase and vendor-specific placement confirmation.
